description: DSK-2 remediation — capability for the main window. Grants the default core permission set (path, event, window, webview, app, image, resources, menu, tray) so the bundled launcher UI (../ui) gets a working IPC bridge now that app.withGlobalTauri is enabled in tauri.conf.json. The app's own commands registered in the invoke_handler (app_version, clear_session) are allowed on local app origins by the Tauri 2 ACL default for application commands, so they need no explicit permission entries here; remote pages (a connected server) resolve to a Remote origin and are denied unless a remote capability explicitly grants them.
